reviews.body:
LGTM, thanks.

I checked [the archived original row 353](https://web.archive.org/web/20260723211215id_/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/open.html) and its definitions 94, 100 and 117: the total-domination minimum, induced subgraphs and vertex component orders match this statement. Independently reconstructing the manuscript's 25-vertex tree reproduces the certificate's 24 edges and gives a ten-vertex total dominating set, nine degree-two components and largest maximum-degree component order three, so the universal bound fails.

The pinned proof's negation and separate exact-statement audit match the proposed assertion, with identical domination definitions and dependency pins. I inspected the author's reported kernel/axiom audit; I did not independently rerun the external Lean proof.

title: WrittenOnTheWallII: certify the disproof of conjecture 353
